comparator: frozen cap10-tuned-v1 2D baseline and Uni-Mol-derived augmented arm
single_intended_change: replace the three Uni-Mol-derived scalar inputs with the same three scalar formulas computed from frozen GROVER-base 2D atom states
rationale: Concatenation is the complete official two-view GROVER atom representation and avoids selecting one internal message-passing view after observing results.

feature_generation.reason: The frozen pretrained 2D encoder is evaluated deterministically and uses no conformer or coordinate generation. Features are generated once.
feature_generation.parallelization: four independent query-scoped GPU workers over contiguous query ranges
